boat: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite for a Mac desktop fishing pet. The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE only. Create an original isolated little wooden rowboat carrying one seated friendly toy-like angler with tan straw hat, cream shirt, dark blue trousers, brown backpack, a warm glowing lantern and a small tackle chest. Angler faces right holding a bamboo fishing rod that reaches toward upper right, with delicate fishing line and red/cream bobber to the right. Include only a small oval patch of crystal turquoise water under the boat, soft reflections, a few little ripples and a hint of submerged pastel coral near its edge. True transparent alpha everywhere outside the boat/water diorama. NO rectangular scene background, no sky, no horizon, no UI, no typography. Style closely matches the reference: high quality rounded 3D clay/toy game rendering, smooth bevels, tactile wood grain, soft ambient occlusion, luminous blue/turquoise water, warm peach sunlight, gentle charming proportions. Not pixel art, not outlines, not flat vector, not a photographic human. Composition: wide 3:2 asset, whole rod/bobber and water oval contained within the canvas with generous transparent margin. Boat large enough to read at 300 pixels. Three-quarter side view at slightly elevated eye level. Refined game-ready art.

Reference image is STYLE ONLY: match its lovely rounded 3D clay/toy materials, softly beveled forms, creamy highlights, luminous pastel ocean-game look. Create a SINGLE SQUARE 2048x2048 transparent PNG atlas in an EXACT 4 COLUMN by 5 ROW uniform invisible grid, exactly 20 separate marine animal sprites. No title, NO labels, no letters, no numbers, no grid lines, no checkerboard, no water, no props. True transparent alpha background. Each complete animal is centered in its OWN equal cell, with at least 15% empty margin to every cell edge and no crossing boundaries.
